title: Sor Juana Inés de la Cruz
summary: Sor Juana Inés de la Cruz was a New Spain poet, playwright and nun, born at San Miguel Nepantla in the mid-17th century. After serving at the viceroy's court, she entered the Convent of San Jerónimo in 1669. Her Respuesta defended women's right to study. She died on 17 April 1695 while nursing sisters during an epidemic.

uncertainty.note: Birth year is disputed: 1648 (EBSCO, baptismal record believed to be hers) or 1651 (traditional, Poets.org).

as_recorded.value: probably November 1648; baptismal record dated December 2, 1648; traditional date November 12, 1651; died April 17, 1695
